stops.note: the root adjective and verb of trust
from fier 'to trust', naming a solemn promise
stops.meaning: a promise, a pledge of trust

stops.note: the past participle of fiancer 'to betroth' was used as a noun for the betrothed person
stops.meaning: a person to whom one is betrothed

stops.note: borrowed for a man engaged to be married, alongside the earlier-borrowed feminine fiancee
stops.meaning: a man to whom one is engaged

current_meaning: a person to whom one is engaged to be married
